mkdir -p /app/output && cat > /app/pipeline.sql << 'EOF'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE pageviews AS
SELECT
  user_id,
  CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_time,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(utm_source), ''), 'unknown') AS utm_source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(utm_medium), ''), 'unknown') AS utm_medium,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(utm_campaign), ''), 'unknown') AS utm_campaign
FROM read_csv_auto('/app/data/pageviews.csv', header=true);

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE sessions AS
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN event_time - lag(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) > INTERVAL '30 minutes'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS new_session_flag
  FROM pageviews
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_seq
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  session_seq + 1 AS session_number,
  MIN(event_time) AS session_start,
  ARG_MIN(utm_source, event_time) AS utm_source,
  ARG_MIN(utm_medium, event_time) AS utm_medium,
  ARG_MIN(utm_campaign, event_time) AS utm_campaign
FROM numbered
GROUP BY user_id, session_seq;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conversions AS
SELECT
  user_id,
  CAST(converted_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS converted_at,
  CAST(revenue AS DOUBLE) AS revenue,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY converted_at) AS conversion_number
FROM read_csv_auto('/app/data/conversions.csv', header=true);

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE attribution AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    s.user_id,
    c.conversion_number,
    s.session_number,
    s.session_start,
    s.utm_source, s.utm_medium, s.utm_campaign,
    c.converted_at,
    c.revenue
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN conversions c
    ON s.user_id = c.user_id
   AND s.session_start <= c.converted_at
   AND s.session_start >= c.converted_at - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
paths AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, conversion_number) AS total_sessions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, conversion_number ORDER BY session_start, session_number) AS session_position
  FROM joined
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE WHEN session_position = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS first_touch_points,
    CASE WHEN session_position = total_sessions THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS last_touch_points,
    CASE
      WHEN total_sessions = 1 THEN 1.0
      WHEN total_sessions = 2 THEN 0.5
      WHEN session_position = 1 OR session_position = total_sessions THEN 0.4
      ELSE 0.2 / (total_sessions - 2)
    END AS positional_points,
    1.0 / total_sessions AS linear_points,
    POW(2.0, -((epoch(converted_at) - epoch(session_start)) / 86400.0) / 7.0) AS decay_weight
  FROM paths
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT *,
    decay_weight / SUM(decay_weight) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, conversion_number) AS time_decay_points
  FROM scored
),
rounded AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    user_id || '_' || conversion_number AS conversion_id,
    user_id || '_s' || session_number AS session_id,
    session_start,
    utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign,
    total_sessions,
    session_position,
    ROUND(first_touch_points, 4) AS first_touch_points,
    ROUND(last_touch_points, 4) AS last_touch_points,
    ROUND(positional_points, 4) AS positional_points,
    ROUND(linear_points, 4) AS linear_points,
    ROUND(time_decay_points, 4) AS time_decay_points,
    ROUND(revenue, 4) AS revenue
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT
  *,
  ROUND(first_touch_points * revenue, 4) AS first_touch_revenue,
  ROUND(last_touch_points * revenue, 4) AS last_touch_revenue,
  ROUND(positional_points * revenue, 4) AS positional_revenue,
  ROUND(linear_points * revenue, 4) AS linear_revenue,
  ROUND(time_decay_points * revenue, 4) AS time_decay_revenue
FROM rounded;

COPY (
  SELECT user_id, conversion_id, session_id, session_start, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign,
    total_sessions, session_position,
    first_touch_points, last_touch_points, positional_points, linear_points, time_decay_points,
    revenue, first_touch_revenue, last_touch_revenue, positional_revenue, linear_revenue, time_decay_revenue
  FROM attribution
  ORDER BY user_id, conversion_id, session_position
) TO '/app/output/attribution.csv' (HEADER, DELIMITER ',');

COPY (
  SELECT
    utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign,
    COUNT(*) AS total_sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT conversion_id) AS total_conversions_attributed,
    ROUND(SUM(first_touch_revenue), 4) AS first_touch_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(last_touch_revenue), 4) AS last_touch_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(positional_revenue), 4) AS positional_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(linear_revenue), 4) AS linear_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(time_decay_revenue), 4) AS time_decay_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(first_touch_revenue) / COUNT(*), 4) AS first_touch_roas,
    ROUND(SUM(last_touch_revenue) / COUNT(*), 4) AS last_touch_roas,
    ROUND(SUM(positional_revenue) / COUNT(*), 4) AS positional_roas,
    ROUND(SUM(linear_revenue) / COUNT(*), 4) AS linear_roas,
    ROUND(SUM(time_decay_revenue) / COUNT(*), 4) AS time_decay_roas
  FROM attribution
  GROUP BY utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign
  ORDER BY time_decay_revenue DESC, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign
) TO '/app/output/channel_summary.csv' (HEADER, DELIMITER ',');
EOF
